details.text: Fixed a Next.js (Turbopack) / webpack 5 build failure ("Module not found: Can't resolve './lib/'") that could occur when bundling this SDK
Fixed a bug where a key event (or other status notification) arriving in the same BLE packet batch as a display acknowledgment could be silently dropped
Fixed a scheduling issue where the display-output retry loop could monopolize the main thread in a foreground tab, delaying delivery of other events (including key presses)
Added braille translation API powered by liblouis: translateText, backTranslateText, buildMultiLineData, setBrailleLanguage, setBrailleGrade, setNumberOfBraillePerLine
Added BrailleLanguage support for 32 languages, with configurable grade (GradeOption) and word-wrap width (NumberOfBraillePerLine)
displayTextData now accepts plain text via needsTranslation, auto-translating and word-wrapping to the device's text width
Added requestVibrator API for vibration pulse control (Run/Stop pattern)
Added single-key state callbacks: onKeyDown / onKeyUp
Added DotPadKey enum for individual key identification
Fixed to keep working properly when the browser tab is in the background
